page.layout: One scanned image showing a closed book in its limp vellum or parchment binding, viewed from the front cover with the fore-edge and head of the text block visible. No printed text is visible on the scan: the page shows only the cover, three binding sewing supports on the spine side, stains, and green fragments.
page.notes: The scan shows the outside of the cover, not a printed text page. Only stains, binding wear, and a faint ruled border near the edges are visible; no printed words, numbers, or headings can be read. The brown marks are stains, not handwriting or printed matter, and were left out.
